The Kozy Vet

Home vet visits for dogs and cats across Mumbai, by a licensed veterinarian. Home visits, at-home vaccinations, check-ups, treatments and follow-up care, in the comfort of your home.

Emergencies that need surgery or hospitalisation are referred to a full-service veterinary hospital.

Visit hours

Monday to Thursday, Saturday and Sunday
9:00 AM to 7:00 PM

Closed on Fridays. Outside working hours, charges are doubled.
